reference_sql:
SELECT product_id, product_name
FROM products
WHERE product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM competitor_prices WHERE competitor = 'Stroomhuis')
alternatives:
SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name
FROM products p
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM competitor_prices cp
  WHERE cp.product_id = p.product_id
    AND cp.competitor = 'Stroomhuis'
)

SELECT DISTINCT p.product_id, p.product_name
FROM products p
JOIN competitor_prices cp ON cp.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE cp.competitor = 'Stroomhuis'

other_way.sql:
SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name
FROM products p
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM competitor_prices cp
  WHERE cp.product_id = p.product_id
    AND cp.competitor = 'Stroomhuis'
)
other_way.tradeoff: EXISTS with a link to the outer product gives the same rows; IN is shorter when the list needs no link.
